headline: SSH opened to the entire internet on production app instances

findings.evidence_ref: New ingress rule in security.tf with port 22 (SSH) and cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
findings.explanation: The change opens SSH access from anywhere on the internet to production app instances. While the intent is to help on-call, the implementation allows anyone globally to attempt SSH connections, drastically expanding the attack surface and enabling brute-force and credential compromise attempts. Restrict cidr_blocks to specific on-call IP ranges or VPN CIDR before merging, or implement Session Manager access now rather than shipping an open SSH rule.
